title_zh: 确认气流演示的操作与入场限制

scenario.label_zh: 工作坊气流设备与进入规则
scenario.goal_zh: 澄清设备旋钮的用途，依据课堂给定规则决定由讲师操作并把观众留在标线外

context_zh: 虚构科学工作坊筹备中，两人对照教师提供的设备及场地说明，不提供实际设备操作指导。
author: author-phase09-a

sentences.speaker: Theo
sentences.text: Does this dial regulate the flow of air through the demonstration tube?

sentences.speaker: Mei
sentences.text: That is what the equipment sheet says. The tutor will operate it during the demonstration.

sentences.speaker: Theo
sentences.text: Can visitors stand beside the table?

sentences.speaker: Mei
sentences.text: No. The safety regulation on this room sheet requires a clear space around the equipment.

sentences.speaker: Theo
sentences.text: So we need to restrict access to the marked area, not close the whole room.

sentences.speaker: Mei
sentences.text: Exactly. The restriction applies to the area inside the line. Visitors can watch from the seats outside it.

sentences.speaker: Theo
sentences.text: Then I'll put the seats beyond the line and leave the controls to the tutor.

sentences.speaker: Mei
sentences.text: Agreed. We will explain that arrangement when the group arrives.
